minimum_rule: A run measures speed only if the GPU is busy long enough and evenly enough. Two rules, the larger wins: (1) at least 1 s of photons, so that the launch and the clock's ramp-up don't dominate; (2) at least 32 chunks per resident thread, so that every SM gets a fair share and the slowest one doesn't decide the time (at 10⁷ photons on the laptop: 9 766 chunks for 27 648 threads, and pass times varied 0.6–1.6×; research/pass_order.py).
